description.value: Deep Cove Caf/Eh is a café nestled in the scenic Deep Cove neighbourhood of North Vancouver, a beloved endpoint for cyclists riding out from the city along the inlet. The name is a knowing Canadian pun on 'café' and 'eh.' It offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a natural rest stop after exploring the local trails and waterfront.
